g.text: each cell of C is one row of A times one column of B
B sits above C and A sits left of C,
so row i of A lines up with row i of C
and column j of B lines up with column j of C.
The grids are drawn to scale:
A is a short wide strip, B a tall strip,
the one cell C[i][j] they produce
a few threads, one block of rows each
green sliver = the arithmetic (same 10,000 cells, same result). Per cell: ≈2.3 µs of math, ≈227 µs of thread overhead.
